name: identity and placement
what it tests: id, unit, slot, position and global number agree; the exercise appears once

name: skeleton conformance
what it tests: slot, type, path and minutes match the skeleton; only rows 9, 14, 17 vary, within their pair

name: item form
what it tests: rubric <=8 words from the template; example item 0; count in band; the eleven item-writing rules; no script beside its own audio task

name: lexis and coverage
what it tests: every word in the cumulative Word File; >=98% coverage in texts; <=3 glossed items in a Model

name: key integrity
what it tests: key present and shaped for the type; variants listed; no letter over 40%; no repeated key sequence in the unit

name: visual integrity
what it tests: exists, type and class declared, referred to by the rubric or carrying task data, adjacent, labels in the Word File, alt text <=25 words, 4.5:1 and 3:1 contrast, colour never alone

name: pedagogical warrant
what it tests: one of the 32 descriptors; a one-verb statement of what the learner does; the no-guess test

name: completeness and order
what it tests: 32 exercises in skeleton order; 270 +/- 10 minutes; Words before Hear it; one video; two listenings in two versions

name: internal spacing
what it tests: each of the 48 new items three times inside the unit, in two or more slots

name: variety and investment
what it tests: no two consecutive types; five visual classes; one new visual type; four personalization exercises; Drills blocked, never interleaved

name: media integrity
what it tests: audio 30-60 s clean and 30-70 s natural; video 60-150 s; scripts match recordings; two hesitation or overlap features in the natural take

name: descriptor closure
what it tests: four descriptors, each with two exercises and one Can I? item; Can I? covers grammar, lexis, function, pronunciation

name: lexical
what it tests: no item of p re-taught in u; items of p due in u appear; u's Word File a superset of p's; the ten-encounter schedule on track

name: grammatical
what it tests: u teaches no point of p; u uses one of p's points productively; u uses nothing from a later unit; no Notice box contradiction

name: duplication and keys
what it tests: no shared 7-gram outside the allow-list; no repeated item set; different key-letter sequences; at most two shared phrases; no reused unit-opener visual

name: world continuity
what it tests: every stated fact about every recurring character agrees, or the text accounts for the change; places and spellings match; the drawn cast matches

name: the ladder
what it tests: reading length, sentence length, new-item load, audio wpm and output length all >= p's; coverage >=98%; no text easier by more than one band
